title: अष्टचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Balarama gives gifts at Indra's tirtha, and at the Adityatirtha he is told of the sage Asita Devala's yoga. The sacred place of the rishi Kashyapa is praised as the place where Vishnu performed sacrifices.
summary.kn: ಬಲರಾಮ ಇಂದ್ರತೀರ್ಥದಲ್ಲಿ ದಾನ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಆದಿತ್ಯತೀರ್ಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಋಷಿ ಅಸಿತ ದೇವಲನ ಯೋಗದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೇಳಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಶ್ಯಪ ಋಷಿಯ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಸ್ಥಳವನ್ನು ವಿಷ್ಣು ಯಜ್ಞ ಮಾಡಿದ ಸ್ಥಳವೆಂದು ಹೊಗಳಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: बलराम इन्द्रतीर्थ में दान देते हैं, और आदित्यतीर्थ में ऋषि असित देवल के योग की कथा सुनाई जाती है। ऋषि कश्यप के पवित्र स्थान की प्रशंसा उस स्थान के रूप में होती है जहाँ विष्णु ने यज्ञ किए।
summary.te: బలరాముడు ఇంద్రతీర్థంలో దానాలు ఇస్తాడు; ఆదిత్యతీర్థంలో అసిత దేవల ఋషి యోగం గురించి చెప్పబడుతుంది. విష్ణువు యజ్ఞాలు చేసిన స్థలంగా కశ్యప ఋషి పవిత్ర స్థలం ప్రశంసించబడుతుంది.
summary.ta: பலராமன் இந்திர தீர்த்தத்தில் தானம் அளிக்க, ஆதித்ய தீர்த்தத்தில் முனிவர் அசித தேவலரின் யோகம் கூறப்படுகிறது. விஷ்ணு வேள்விகள் செய்த இடமாகக் காசியபரின் புனிதத் தலம் புகழப்படுகிறது.
summary.ml: ബലരാമൻ ഇന്ദ്രതീർത്ഥത്തിൽ ദാനങ്ങൾ നൽകുന്നു; ആദിത്യതീർത്ഥത്തിൽ അസിത ദേവലന്റെ യോഗത്തെക്കുറിച്ച് അദ്ദേഹത്തോട് പറയുന്നു. വിഷ്ണു യജ്ഞങ്ങൾ നടത്തിയ സ്ഥലമെന്ന നിലയിൽ കശ്യപ ഋഷിയുടെ പുണ്യസ്ഥലം പ്രശംസിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.48; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

sections.title: सारस्वतपर्व
sections.titleEn: Sarasvata Parva (Balarama's pilgrimage on the Sarasvati)

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
इन्द्रतीर्थं ततो गत्वा यदूनां प्रवरो बली ।
विप्रेभ्यो धनरत्नानि ददौ स्नात्वा यथाविधि ॥

meaning.en: Then the mighty chief of the Yadavas went to Indratirtha, bathed there in due form, and gave wealth and jewels to the brahmins.

verses.text:
तत्र ह्यमरराजोऽसावीजे क्रतुशतेन ह ।
बृहस्पतेश्च देवेशः प्रददौ विपुलं धनम् ॥

meaning.en: It was there that the king of the gods once performed a hundred sacrifices, and the lord of the gods gave Brihaspati vast riches.

verses.text:
निरर्गलान्सजारूथ्यान्सर्वान्विविधदक्षिणान् ।
आजहार क्रतूंस्तत्र यथोक्तान्वेदपारगैः ॥

meaning.en: With Vedic masters officiating, he carried out there all the prescribed rites, with unrestricted gifts, with the jarutha offerings, and with many kinds of fees.

verses.text:
तान्क्रतून्भरतश्रेष्ठ शतकृत्वो महाद्युतिः ।
पूरयामास विधिवत्ततः ख्यातः शतक्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: O best of Bharatas, that radiant one completed those sacrifices a hundred times as the rule requires, and so he became known as Shatakratu, the lord of a hundred rites.

verses.text:
तस्य नाम्ना च तत्तीर्थं शिवं पुण्यं सनातनम् ।
इन्द्रतीर्थमिति ख्यातं सर्वपापप्रमोचनम् ॥

meaning.en: From his name that holy, auspicious, ancient ford came to be called Indratirtha, and it frees one from all sins.

verses.text:
उपस्पृश्य च तत्रापि विधिवन्मुसलायुधः ।
ब्राह्मणान्पूजयित्वा च पानाच्छादनभोजनैः ।
शुभं तीर्थवरं तस्माद्रामतीर्थं जगाम ह ॥

meaning.en: Bathing there as well in proper form, the plough-wielder honored the brahmins with drink, clothing and food, and then went from that excellent ford to the lovely Ramatirtha.

verses.text:
यत्र रामो महाभागो भार्गवः सुमहातपाः ।
असकृत्पृथिवीं सर्वां हतक्षत्रियपुंगवाम् ॥

meaning.en: There the greatly blessed Rama of the Bhrigu line, a mighty ascetic, had many times destroyed the foremost kshatriyas across the whole earth.

verses.text:
उपाध्यायं पुरस्कृत्य कश्यपं मुनिसत्तमम् ।
अयजद्वाजपेयेन सोऽश्वमेधशतेन च ।
प्रददौ दक्षिणार्थं च पृथिवीं वै ससागराम् ॥

meaning.en: Placing the sage Kashyapa, best of munis, in front as his priest, he performed the Vajapeya and a hundred horse sacrifices, and gave the earth with its oceans as the priest's fee.

verses.text:
रामो दत्त्वा धनं तत्र द्विजेभ्यो जनमेजय ।
उपस्पृश्य यथान्यायं पूजयित्वा तथा द्विजान् ॥

meaning.en: O Janamejaya, having given away his wealth there to the brahmins, Rama bathed as the rule requires and honored the twice-born.

verses.text:
पुण्ये तीर्थे शुभे देशे वसु दत्त्वा शुभाननः ।
मुनींश्चैवाभिवाद्याथ यमुनातीर्थमागमत् ॥

meaning.en: In that holy ford, in that auspicious place, the fair-faced one gave away riches, saluted the sages, and then came to Yamunatirtha.

verses.text:
यत्रानयामास तदा राजसूयं महीपते ।
पुत्रोऽदितेर्महाभागो वरुणो वै सितप्रभः ॥

meaning.en: There, O lord of the earth, the greatly blessed bright-hued Varuna, son of Aditi, once performed the Rajasuya sacrifice.

verses.text:
तत्र निर्जित्य संग्रामे मानुषान्दैवतांस्तथा ।
वरं क्रतुं समाजह्रे वरुणः परवीरहा ॥

meaning.en: Having conquered men and gods in battle there, Varuna, slayer of enemy heroes, carried out that excellent rite.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्क्रतुवरे वृत्ते संग्रामः समजायत ।
देवानां दानवानां च त्रैलोक्यस्य क्षयावहः ॥

meaning.en: When that supreme sacrifice was finished, a war broke out between the gods and the danavas, which brought ruin to the three worlds.

verses.text:
राजसूये क्रतुश्रेष्ठे निवृत्ते जनमेजय ।
जायते सुमहाघोरः संग्रामः क्षत्रियान्प्रति ॥

meaning.en: O Janamejaya, when the Rajasuya, best of rites, is completed, a terrible great war against the kshatriyas arises.

verses.text:
सीरायुधस्तदा रामस्तस्मिंस्तीर्थवरे तदा ।
तत्र स्नात्वा च दत्त्वा च द्विजेभ्यो वसु माधवः ॥

meaning.en: Then Rama, wielder of the plough, bathed at that excellent ford, gave wealth to the brahmins, and was Madhava still.

verses.text:
वनमाली ततो हृष्टः स्तूयमानो द्विजातिभिः ।
तस्मादादित्यतीर्थं च जगाम कमलेक्षणः ॥

meaning.en: Delighted, garlanded with forest flowers, praised by the twice-born, the lotus-eyed one then went from there to Adityatirtha.

verses.text:
यत्रेष्ट्वा भगवाञ्ज्योतिर्भास्करो राजसत्तम ।
ज्योतिषामाधिपत्यं च प्रभावं चाभ्यपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: O best of kings, there the blessed Sun, the luminary, having sacrificed, gained lordship over the lights and his power.

verses.text:
तस्या नद्यास्तु तीरे वै सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः ।
विश्वेदेवाः समरुतो गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च ह ॥

meaning.en: On the bank of that river all the gods, with Indra, the Vishvedevas, the Maruts, the gandharvas and apsaras, were present.

verses.text:
द्वैपायनः शुकश्चैव कृष्णश्च मधुसूदनः ।
यक्षाश्च राक्षसाश्चैव पिशाचाश्च विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Dvaipayana, Shuka, and Krishna Madhusudana, along with yakshas, rakshasas and pishachas, O lord of the people, were there.

verses.text:
एते चान्ये च बहवो योगसिद्धाः सहस्रशः ।
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे सरस्वत्याः शिवे पुण्ये परंतप ॥

meaning.en: These and many other thousands of perfected yogis stayed at that holy, auspicious ford of the Sarasvati, O scorcher of foes.

verses.text:
तत्र हत्वा पुरा विष्णुरसुरौ मधुकैटभौ ।
आप्लुतो भरतश्रेष्ठ तीर्थप्रवर उत्तमे ॥

meaning.en: In that excellent ford, O best of Bharatas, Vishnu had bathed after he had long ago slain the two asuras Madhu and Kaitabha.

verses.text:
द्वैपायनश्च धर्मात्मा तत्रैवाप्लुत्य भारत ।
संप्राप्तः परमं योगं सिद्धिं च परमां गतः ॥

meaning.en: And the righteous Dvaipayana, O Bharata, bathed right there and reached the highest yoga and the supreme perfection.

verses.text:
असितो देवलश्चैव तस्मिन्नेव महातपाः ।
परमं योगमास्थाय ऋषिर्योगमवाप्तवान् ॥

meaning.en: Asita and Devala, great ascetics, also attained yoga there; that sage took up the highest yoga and won it.
